violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Customer self service counter small refrigerator not maintaining proper temperature. 48 degrees F. Service units as needed. Beige refrigerator in kitchen area operating at 60 degrees F. Muffins and cream cheese spread cups stored in refrigerator. Cream cheese cups to be discarded.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not accurate or not easily readable. Ensure refrigeration thermometers are accurate in all refrigeration units.--Temperature measuring device was not provided. Stem thermometer not provided to accurately temp products.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Three compartment sink was not maintained or operated in the approved three step method. Operate 3 tub sink as follows... 1) Hot soapy water 2) Clear water rinse 3) Sanitizing rinse 4) Air dry all utensils

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Keep items from being placed in front of hand sink to encourage proper hand washing.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Hand soap dispenser not at hand sink.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Popcorn style ceiling in kitchen area. Not properly designed.
Lighting. — --Existing light fixtures did not provide adequate illumination. Single light bulb not sufficient for illuminating entire kitchen area.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Large container of Round Up pesticide stored next to box of coffee cups in under stairs storage closet. Store pesticides away from food service related items.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Keep hand sink accessible. Remove items from in front of hand sink.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Popcorn style ceiling texture not smooth or easily cleanable.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor needs cleaning in kitchen area.
Lighting. — --Existing light fixture does not provide adequate illumination.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material * was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Store Round-Up pesticides away from boxes of coffee cups in storage closet. Store spray bottle of OdorBan/Comet away from food items on kitchen counter.
